answer: Proposal: an oasis reward slot requires each key to send a nonce-masked 1-GiB ripple stream to two independent receivers in the same 10-second window. They sign byte counts and hashes; proposed validators mark the slot umber and forfeit pending pay if either receipt is missing or replayed. A farm can share one generator and rent a fat link, but k keys must transmit k distinct GiB to each receiver concurrently; multicast cannot reuse a stream. Renting still reserves extra simultaneous egress per clone. Without delivery that key earns zero. This burdens honest agents too.
